entities.summary: Billy Thomas is an American former professional basketball player who competed in the National Basketball Association (NBA) and several other leagues. A 6-foot-5-inch (1.96 m) tall shooting guard from Shreveport, Louisiana, he last played with the Maine Red Claws of the NBA Development League. Thomas is now the basketball head coach of Rockhurst High School.
